Wait strategies

Source: R/retry_wait.R
wait_strategies.Rd

Decide how many seconds retry() sleeps after a failed attempt.

Usage

wait_fixed(wait = integer(0))

wait_none()

wait_exp(multiplier = 1, min = 0, max = 4611686018427387904, exp_base = 2)

wait_exp_jitter(base = 0.1, max_delay = 20, jitter = "full")

wait_rand(min = 0, max = 1)

wait_chain(...)

wait_combine(...)

Arguments

wait

Seconds to wait.

multiplier, exp_base

Scale and base of the exponential.

min, max

Lower and upper bound in seconds.

base

Seconds to wait on the first attempt.

max_delay

Longest wait in seconds.

jitter

Jitter type, one of "full", "equal", "decorrelated" or "none".

...

Wait strategies to chain or combine.

Value

A wait strategy to pass to retry().

Details

  • wait_none() does not wait.

  • wait_fixed() waits a fixed time.

  • wait_rand() waits a random time between min and max.

  • wait_exp() waits multiplier * exp_base^(attempt - 1), kept between min and max.

  • wait_exp_jitter() waits base * 2^(attempt - 1), capped at max_delay, then applies jitter: "none", "full" (uniform from 0), "equal" (half fixed, half random) or "decorrelated" (random between base and 3 times the previous wait).

  • wait_chain() uses the n-th strategy for the n-th attempt, then repeats the last.

  • wait_combine() adds strategies together. a + b is the same as wait_combine(a, b).

Examples

wait_fixed(2)
#> <garnish::wait_fixed>
#>  @ wait: num 2
wait_exp(multiplier = 0.5, max = 30)
#> <garnish::wait_exp>
#>  @ multiplier: num 0.5
#>  @ min       : num 0
#>  @ max       : num 30
#>  @ exp_base  : num 2
wait_chain(wait_fixed(1), wait_fixed(5))
#> <garnish::wait_chain>
#>  @ waits:List of 2
#>  .. $ : <garnish::wait_fixed>
#>  ..  ..@ wait: num 1
#>  .. $ : <garnish::wait_fixed>
#>  ..  ..@ wait: num 5
wait_fixed(1) + wait_rand(0, 2)
#> <garnish::wait_combine>
#>  @ waits:List of 2
#>  .. $ : <garnish::wait_fixed>
#>  ..  ..@ wait: num 1
#>  .. $ : <garnish::wait_rand>
#>  ..  ..@ min: num 0
#>  ..  ..@ max: num 2
